name: Unipol Assicurazioni S.p.A.
summary: Unipol Gruppo S.p.A., an Italian company, operates alongside its subsidiaries to offer a comprehensive range of insurance and banking services, primarily within its home country. The company's business activities are segmented into five main areas: Non-Life Insurance, Life Insurance, Banking, Real Estate, and Holding and Other Businesses. Its non-life insurance offerings span a wide array, including coverage for vehicles, sports crafts, and travel; residences and condominiums; commercial operations for businesses, traders, and professionals, along with legal protection; accident and health safeguards; and solutions for investments and welfare. Additionally, Unipol provides life insurance policies and reinsurance services to both individual and corporate clients, leveraging its extensive agency network. Its diversified operations also include managing non-performing loans, developing and managing real estate portfolios, operating resorts and hotels, and engaging in agricultural, harbor, and healthcare ventures. The entity, originally known as Unipol Gruppo Finanziario S.p.A., officially rebranded to Unipol Gruppo S.p.A. in June 2017. Founded in 1961, its headquarters are situated in Bologna, Italy.
